risks.title: Interest rate risk on variable-rate debt
risks.score_rationale: Risk is clearly quantified in the 10-K: a 100 bp increase would reduce net income by $1.4 million. The absence of hedging increases exposure. Although debt has decreased ($223M in 2024 to $124.3M in 2025), the impact remains significant.

risks.title: Difficulty attracting and retaining personnel
risks.score_rationale: Listed first among risks, this factor is critical for a home-based healthcare services company. The risk is qualitative but central, with concerned language around rising costs and potential shortages of qualified staff.

ai_positioning.summary: ADUS does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K filing. Technology references are limited to cybersecurity and risk management.
